description:
A delightful one bedroomed, fully furnished, maisonette set in the heart of vibrant Kingsdown close to local pubs, shops and cafes and only a short distance from the Bristol Royal Infirmary and city centre.The accomodation is set over two floors. Upstairs is the living/dining room and kitchen.  Then down a lovely spiral staircases with a clever area that has previously been used as bike storage.  Once at the bottom of the stairs, this takes you to a cosy bedroom with plenty of space for a study/reading area as well as built in storage which includes a washing machine.  The door to your shower room leads off this area of the property.  Call us now to book in your viewing - we can't wait to hear from you on  .

This property is available with a Deposit Free option which means that instead of paying a traditional five weeks security deposit, you pay a fee of 28% of the first months rent + VAT (subject to a minimum of £120 + VAT) to become a member of a deposit free renting scheme which significantly reduces the up-front costs. This fee is non-refundable and is not a deposit so cannot be used towards covering the cost of any future damage.
